method: Built-in GPT Image; composited real-palette native reference at 8x, approved models and WAIT frames. Original generated art reduced uniformly; no hand-painted contours.

attempts.verdict: Continuous black sticker edges, backward lower-body alignment.
Continuous black contours, superseded by style-fidelity pass.
Improved selective edges; compared with attempt5, denser fine feather detail.
Rejected: wrong identities/pose; model kept Sonic and omitted TALON.
Selected: coarse native-like clusters and visible paired grip.

limits: S3K native +28 centre offset unchanged. Mod flight/carry in S1/S2 borrows the S3K capability; no native S1/S2 carry animation exists. Wings add opaque area relative to rotor-free native body.

style.outline: Selective one-pixel material shadow contours. Sonic dark-blue body edge #242492; Tails warm body edge #B66D49; glove edge #6D6D92; sparse charcoal #242424 in eyes/occlusions. Not continuous black ink. Diagonal clusters may be two pixels thick.
style.shadeSteps: Body three tones (shadow/base/highlight); muzzle two tones; red shoes two; gloves three gray/white levels plus small extra near-white accents.
style.light: Upper left; small stepped bright clusters on head, upper-left gloves and shoe toes; lower/right shaded.
style.dither: No regular checkerboard dithering observed in these five poses.
style.highlight: Small stepped pixel clusters, not gradients or broad smooth rim light.
style.reduction: Nearest-neighbour at manually locked head/torso scale, MICA 6:1 / TALON 6.5:1; shoe/glove plane from source pair, translated to native centre offset. Palette-only reduction: MICA12 opaque slots, TALON10; no global outline repaint.

nativeReferences: S3K Sonic mappings $90/$91/$92, real SonicAndTails palette, 8x nearest
S3K Tails mappings $A2/$A1, same real palette; no separate rotor
First two attempts used $A0 as initial posture; final style attempts use the $A2 carrier pair.
